observation.command:
echo "=== Can tooling container run docker? ==="; docker exec vereinfacht-tooling-1 sh -c 'which docker; docker ps 2>&1 | head -2' 2>&1
echo
echo "=== Laravel Auth::attempt for seeded super admin ==="
docker exec -w /var/www/html/api vereinfacht-tooling-1 php artisan tinker --execute="var_dump(\Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth::attempt(['email'=>'hello@vereinfacht.digital','password'=>'password']));" 2>&1 | tail -3
echo
echo "=== Laravel Auth::attempt for seeded club admin (web frontend user) ==="
docker exec -w /var/www/html/api vereinfacht-tooling-1 php artisan tinker --execute="var_dump(\Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth::attempt(['email'=>'club-admin-1@example.org','password'=>'password']));" 2>&1 | tail -3
